{{Quote|Hosk Station, of all the uncivilized, remote, desolate places to be sent to, why did it have to be here, Artoo?|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Droids Special 1">''[[Star Wars: Droids Special]]''</ref>}}
'''Hosk Station''' was a major trading port and space station that covered the surface of [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba's]] largest moon. The station's close proximity to several wealthy systems allowed it to become an important trading center.<ref name="EVV" />

==Description==
[[File:HoskStation_egvv.png|thumb|left|180px|Hosk Station [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]].]]

Hosk Station was an [[Esseles-class space station|''Esseles''-class space station]] built by [[Alderaan Royal Engineers]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was used as a docking and transfer point for many [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It was, in many ways, a typical space station with a population of 5 million sentients. Artificial gravity and atmosphere generators provided a comfortable climate for [[Human/Legends|Humans]], while different sections of the station had different gravities and atmospheres to accommodate other sentient species. A computerized map of Hosk Station could be accessed from any public data terminal.<ref name="EVV" />

Hosk Station maintained almost any form of business imaginable, from small businesses and droid dealerships to opulent restaurants and luxurious hotels. The station's interior was filled with starship repair and construction bays. For defense, the station was equipped with ten [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and a contingent of 8 short-range [[Zebra starfighter]]s. Twelve [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors were also mounted near the main docking bay clusters. Incoming starships were required to slave their computers to the starport controllers and allow the station's tractor beams to handle docking procedures.<ref name="EVV" />

==History==
[[File:Droids_Kalarba.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Hosk Station visible from [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]].]]

Hosk Station was first built as a supply and repair station by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Its location was chosen because of its close proximity to the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], at the innermost border of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], and its low gravity, which was useful for capital ships coming in to dock. The [[Kalarba system/Legends|Kalarba system's]] asteroid belts also provided a convenient supply of metals and ores.<ref name="EVV" />

After Hosk Station was in use for thousands of years, it lost its purpose. Many of the Colonies region planets had stabilized, and trouble spots occurred in areas that were closer to other supply stations. As a result, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] sold the station to civilian interests.<ref name="EVV" />

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] met with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] aboard Hosk Station in the hopes of avoiding a conflict over [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="EGTW Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-6-showdown-at-naboo|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 6: Showdown at Naboo}}</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invasion, Hosk Station crashed into [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]] through the use of the [[Yo'gand's Core]] tactic during the [[Battle of Kalarba]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]. Although armed with ten [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and a fleet of Zebra fighters, the station was overwhelmed and utterly destroyed.
